followUps.reason: Investigate why the order status transitioned to FAILED despite gateway capture (ev_02, ev_03).
Check settlement batch lines for this payment given the D3_LEDGER_MISSING rule and hasSettlementBatch flag (ev_02).
Reconcile expected vs actual ledger net totals for the settlement batch (D3_LEDGER_MISSING).

findings.statement: Webhook delivery for payment.captured event failed after 3 attempts with last HTTP status 500.
Order status transitioned to FAILED due to lack of payment confirmation within 15 minutes, even though gateway shows the payment as CAPTURED.

data.narrative: Webhook delivery for the payment.captured event failed due to an HTTP 500 server error (fd_01). As a result, payment confirmation was not received, causing the order state to diverge to FAILED despite successful capture at the gateway (fd_02).
